description: The night before the auction, a skilled thief, known only as 'The Fox', infiltrates the local museum through a ventilation shaft.
The Fox disables the security cameras and alarms in the exhibit hall using a customized jamming device.
The Fox smashes the display case and removes the 18th-century manuscript, replacing it with a convincing fake.
The Fox escapes the museum through the same ventilation shaft, leaving behind no signs of forced entry or exit.
The next morning, the archivist, Clara, arrives at the museum and discovers the broken display case and the missing manuscript.
Clara realizes that the manuscript was not just any valuable item, but contained a hidden code that could change the course of historical research.
The Fox contacts a wealthy collector, known as 'The Patron', to arrange a meeting to sell the stolen manuscript.
The Patron sends a representative to authenticate the manuscript and verify its hidden code, before agreeing to the sale.
The Fox becomes suspicious of The Patron's true intentions and decides to investigate The Patron's background, fearing a double-cross.
Clara starts to suspect that the theft is more than just a simple crime, and that the perpetrator may be trying to hide something much bigger, initiating her own investigation.
Clara discovers a cryptic message on the museum's website that hints at The Fox's true identity
The Fox breaks into The Patron's mansion to gather evidence of their suspected double-cross
The Fox discovers a hidden safe in The Patron's mansion containing documents revealing a network of illicit collectors
Clara tracks down a former associate of The Fox, who provides her with a lead on The Fox's possible whereabouts
Clara follows the lead to an abandoned warehouse on the outskirts of town
The Fox sets a trap for Clara at the warehouse, anticipating her arrival
